Package index

Rulebooks

A rulebook holds every planning rule for one plan, with a citation for every value. Build one in R, or read it from YAML, JSON or a spreadsheet.

rulebook()
Create a rulebook
add_zone() add_overlay() add_area() add_bonus() add_entitlement() add_unmodelled()
Add rules to a rulebook
set_zone_map() set_zone_families() set_defaults() set_morphology() set_conversion() set_ground() set_variant_choice()
Set rulebook-wide settings
read_rulebook() write_rulebook()
Read and write rulebooks
rulebook_template()
Rulebooks as spreadsheets
rulebook_example() rulebook_examples() rulebook_example_path()
Rulebooks shipped with plancap

Zones

The rules a zone applies to every site in it.

zone() zone_changes()
Define a zone
height_limit()
Height limit
ratio()
A share of site area
bands() band_value()
Banded values and ratios
building_form()
Building form limits
density()
Density rules
use_mix()
Uses a zone enables

Setbacks

Yards, recession and daylight planes, upper-level and height-proportional setbacks: every rule that keeps a building back from a boundary.

yard() plane() upper_level_setback() proportional_setback() setback_profile()
Setback rules: yards, planes and everything that keeps a building back
setback_distance()
Required setback distance at a height
conditions()
Conditions under which a rule applies
boundary_classes()
Boundary classes

overlay()
Overlays: spatial layers that change the rules
area()
Areas: precincts, sub-precincts and site-specific controls
sub_area()
A sub-area of an area

Bonuses and entitlements
unmodelled_rule()

rule_table()
Every rule in a rulebook as one table

Path to the rulebook JSON Schema

Scenarios and site preparation

A scenario is a rulebook with its parcels and maps. Preparing it turns parcels into sites with classified boundaries, ready for the engine; prepared steps are reused across scenarios that share their inputs.

scenario() scenario_change()
Scenarios: a rulebook with its maps and parcels
prepare_sites()
Prepare sites for a scenario
clear_site_cache()
Clear plancap's cache of prepared sites

The building envelope

Each site’s stack of storey footprints, clipped by every rule that applies at each height and capped by site ratios.

build_envelopes()
Build the storey-by-storey building envelope of every site

Site and boundary types

Road frontages, side and rear boundaries, corner, through and rear sites, access legs, water boundaries and road widths, each with the evidence for the call.

find_road_frontages() find_side_rear() find_corner_sites() find_through_sites() find_rear_sites() find_access_legs() find_water_boundaries() find_road_widths() site_metrics()
Identify what each boundary and site is
check_morphology() plot_morphology()
Check and draw how sites and boundaries were classified
